title: Choose the diagram path
subtitle: The right tool depends on whether trust or speed is load-bearing
source: Mermaid is already in the documentation build and is fastest for simple technical flows. Kolam Local keeps source material on the machine and emits editable HTML plus SVG. Kolam Verified chooses a business framework and requires evidence for named framework claims.
